adjudication.rationale: The diff clearly changes CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar to an array and, for COLLECTIVE team events, appends multiple team members’ destination calendars into `evt.destinationCalendar` (`handleNewBooking.ts`, building `teamDestinationCalendars` and `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`). However, when persisting the Booking, it still connects only the first entry: `connect: { id: evt.destinationCalendar[0].id }` (same file near the Prisma create payload). Later flows (confirm/editLocation/webhooks/cron) rebuild `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` from `booking.destinationCalendar` (singular relation) and wrap it as a 1-element array (or empty), so the multi-calendar list is not persisted and cannot be reconstructed from Booking data. This is a real, diff-grounded architecture/scope gap, though not necessarily an immediate runtime defect if references are the intended source of truth.
